> hi @Concurrensee! thanks for the PR! What Models have you tried this one? I'm a little hesitant to change the default ROCm backend for everything. The regression you were reporting seems isolated to sliding window, so maybe we change the backends if we detect that type, but otherwise try to leave it relatively alone? What do you think?

Hi @dllehr-amd, the model tried is `Cohere Command R 7B`, the performance regression observed is from 9.62 ms -> 155.79 ms. The step to reproduce is:
```
docker run --device=/dev/kfd --device=/dev/dri --group-add video --group-add render 
--shm-size 128G --network host 
-e VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 -e VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_PAGED_ATTN=1 
-e VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MHA=1 -e VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTENTION=0 
-e CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 -e ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 
vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:v0.19.1 
--model CohereLabs/c4ai-command-r7b-12-2024 
--max-model-len 131072 --enable-chunked-prefill 
--block-size 64 --trust-remote-code

vllm bench serve --model CohereLabs/c4ai-command-r7b-12-2024 
--dataset-name random --random-input-len 100000 --random-output-len 1000 
--ignore-eos --num-prompts 16 --max-concurrency 1 --request-rate inf
```

The default backend is still the ROCM_ATTN, it just changed when user explicitly set `(VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 + VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MHA=1)`, ROCM_AITER_FA goes ahead of ROCM_ATTN

## Code Review

This pull request updates the ROCm platform backend selection logic to exclude ROCM_ATTN when a model uses sliding window attention, citing performance concerns. A new helper function, _model_uses_sliding_window, was introduced to check the model configuration. The review feedback correctly identifies a potential AttributeError in this helper function if the model configuration is null and provides a code suggestion to ensure null safety.

![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

The `model_config` variable is retrieved using `getattr` with a default of `None`. If `model_config` is `None`, the subsequent call to `model_config.get_sliding_window()` will raise an `AttributeError`. A null check should be added to ensure safety, as `VllmConfig` allows `model_config` to be `None` by default.

```suggestion
    model_config = getattr(vllm_config, "model_config", None)
    return model_config is not None and model_config.get_sliding_window() is not None
```

Would it make sense to just add this code section, before ROCM_AITER_FA and leave ROCM_ATTN as the default unless it's SWA, and then leave it off entirely?  

Also if AITER isn't available will this code essentially force SWA to go through TRITON_ATTN?

hi @Concurrensee! thanks for the PR!  What Models have you tried this one?  I'm a little hesitant to change the default ROCm backend for everything. The regression you were reporting seems isolated to sliding window, so maybe we change the backends if we detect that type, but otherwise try to leave it relatively alone?  What do you think?

`rocm_aiter_ops.is_mha_enabled():` this only goes through when env  `(VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 + VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MHA=1)`. If we keep ROCM_ATTN ahead of it, then even user explicitly set this env combo, ROCM_ATTN still has higher priority and vllm still runs ROCM_ATTN instead of ROCM_AITER_FA. This is to fix currently that this env combo does not work.

If AITER isn't available, this code will force SWA to go through TRITON_ATTN

detail.body:
1. Move `ROCM_AITER_FA` ahead of `ROCM_ATTN`. When AITER MHA is explicitly enabled via env vars (`VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1` + `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MHA=1`).

detail.title: [ROCm] Fix ROCm Attention Backend Slection

files.patch:
@@ -374,6 +374,13 @@ def flash_attn_triton_available() -> bool:
         return False
 
 
+def _model_uses_sliding_window() -> bool:
+    from vllm.config import get_current_vllm_config
+
+    vllm_config = get_current_vllm_config()
+    return vllm_config.model_config.get_sliding_window() is not None
+
+
 def _get_backend_priorities(
     use_mla: bool,
     use_sparse: bool,
@@ -396,13 +403,14 @@ def _get_backend_priorities(
                 AttentionBackendEnum.TRITON_MLA,
             ]
 
-    backends = []
+    backends: list[AttentionBackendEnum] = []
+    if rocm_aiter_ops.is_mha_enabled():
+        backends.append(AttentionBackendEnum.ROCM_AITER_FA)
+    # ROCM_ATTN right now has extremely slow performance on sliding window attention
     # ROCM_ATTN uses (2, num_blocks, ...) KV cache layout which is
     # incompatible with KV connectors that require blocks-first layout.
-    if not use_kv_connector:
+    if not _model_uses_sliding_window() and not use_kv_connector:
         backends.append(AttentionBackendEnum.ROCM_ATTN)
-    if rocm_aiter_ops.is_mha_enabled():
-        backends.append(AttentionBackendEnum.ROCM_AITER_FA)
     if is_aiter_found_and_supported():
         backends.append(AttentionBackendEnum.ROCM_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN)
     backends.append(AttentionBackendEnum.TRITON_ATTN)
